name: Ogun for VS Code
summary: Check *.workflow.json in VS Code: schema validation, diagnostics, hover, completion, go to definition and the workflow hash, from the Ogun language server or the validator.

settings.name: ogun_path
settings.label: Path to ogun
settings.help: VS Code setting ogun.path. The command-line tool the extension runs.

settings.name: validate_on_save
settings.label: Validate on save
settings.help: VS Code setting ogun.validateOnSave. In CLI mode, runs ogun validate when a file is saved.

settings.name: language_server_path
settings.label: Language server command
settings.help: VS Code setting ogun.languageServer.path. Empty means ogun-lsp on PATH, then ogun lsp.

egress.note: None. The extension runs local commands and never contacts ogund.

implementation.evidence: Node tests against the built ogun-lsp; they do not start VS Code. Not yet published to the VS Code Marketplace or Open VSX.

notes: Chooses language-server or CLI mode at activation; it falls back to ogun validate --json when no server is found, the server does not initialise within 10 s, or it exits later. Read-only: it never runs a workflow and is not an approval surface. It also copies the workflow hash from the status bar or a code lens.
